A mass is suspended from a vertical spring. The mass is pulled downwards causing the spring to
extend further. The mass is held in this position and then released.
Which energy changes occur during the initial movement of the mass when the mass is
released?
gravitational
elastic
kinetic
potential energy
potential energy
energy store
store
store
A
decreases
decreases
increases
B
decreases
increases
increases
C
increases
decreases
decreases
D
increases
increases
decreases
